name: Aira
source:
Zen and Rikka's boss, Aira is the section chief of the Reaper Elite Organisation, "O3BR". Though she appears to be young, she has lived in the realm of the dead for a long time. She is trusted by her subordinates as she guides them with her composed judgements.

[Translation of her [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/un_birth/chara_aira.html]official website profile[/URL].]
